paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: ATL-0009 EVENT_ID: NONE TITLE: Country profile: Ketra SOURCE_NAME: Realm Trade Ministry SOURCE_TYPE: atlas RELIABILITY: 1 PUB_DATE: 2024-01-15 PUB_TIME: 10:45 COUNTRY: Ketra SECTOR: general LANGUAGE: en --- Country profile: Ketra
[P1] Ketra is an electronics maker on the East Sea. It specialises in computer chips and consumer goods and imports the specialty metals and energy needed by its factories.

[P2] The main exports are computer chips and consumer goods. The main imports are specialty metals and LNG. Chip production is concentrated in a small number of large plants, while consumer goods are made across a wider group of medium-sized factories.

[P3] Nexor Chips, a chipmaker, is the best-known firm. The country has container terminals on the coast and a fast road link to the capital, but no single port dominates the way Asgard Port or Midgard Harbour does.
[P4] Chip plants are concentrated in two industrial parks, while consumer goods factories are spread across the capital region. A fast road links both areas to the coast.
